crossRefs.note: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.

translations.web: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.
translations.bsb: So Jacob’s gifts went on before him, while he spent the night in the camp.
translations.kjv: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.
translations.asv: So the present passed over before him: and he himself lodged that night in the company.
